processing_steps.method: vacuum induction melting; cast into cylindrical copper moulds
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cylindrical copper moulds 32 mm in diameter by 186 mm in length; no further heat treatment reported (as-cast terminal state).
Mechanical test specimens cut from cast ingots by spark erosion along the longitudinal axis of the ingot (casting direction); specimen surfaces ground.

structures.overall_structure: Two-phase as-cast Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C: Fe3Al matrix with polygonal grains (120 μm) and cube-like TiC precipitates (2 μm).

phases_present.crystal_structure: D03 (ordered; D03/B2 at about 550 °C and B2/A2 at about 800 °C before melting)

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: compression samples (6×6×10) mm³; tensile flat samples (3.5×5) mm² cross-section with 15 mm gauge length
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: samples cut in direction of longitudinal axis of ingot (casting direction); surfaces ground; ZWICK 1474 universal testing machine

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Room-temperature engineering stress–strain curves reported in compression (Fig. 2b, curve 7) and in tension (Fig. 3b, curve 7) for Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C.
strain_hardening_rate: very high strengthening with almost constant hardening rate until a final stage of parabolic work hardening (Fe-26Al-based alloys in compression)

measurement_conditions.environment: protective argon atmosphere within a radiation furnace
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: samples held 30 min at testing temperature before loading; temperature checked by NiCr-Ni thermocouple on specimen surface

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: room-temperature matrix hardness and yield stress (compression/tension)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: load of 62.5 g; indentation ball with 2.5 mm diameter

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: deformation rate 10^-4 s^-1; elevated-temperature tests in protective argon within radiation furnace; 30 min hold at test temperature; NiCr-Ni thermocouple on specimen surface
characterization_methods.purpose: determine room-temperature ductility, yield stress (compression/tension) and high-temperature strength
characterization_methods.key_findings: Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C room-temperature compression yield 447 MPa, tension yield 342 MPa, total elongation 0.7%.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: SEM-Hitachi S-530 with 20 kV, working distance 15 mm, secondary electrons (SE)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: fracture surfaces of tensile specimens after room-temperature testing
characterization_methods.purpose: investigate fracture surfaces of ruptured tensile specimens
characterization_methods.key_findings: Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C shows mixed smooth intergranular areas bearing cube-like TiC precipitates adjacent to facetted cleavage regions; fracture mode IGD+TGC.

unmapped_findings: Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C shows room-temperature fracture mode IGD+TGC (intergranular decohesion + transgranular cleavage); on the intergranular fracture areas the cube-like TiC precipitates can be clearly distinguished.

Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C exhibits tension-compression asymmetry at room temperature and at 650/800 °C: the compressive yield stress (447 MPa) is higher than the tensile yield stress (342 MPa) at room temperature.
Fe-26Al-2Ti-1C belongs to the Fe-26Al-based alloys that show a yield stress anomaly (anomalous increase in yield strength in compression at intermediate temperatures).
